summative_rubric.title: If-Then Detectives — Summative Rubric

rows.expectation_text: solve problems and create computational representations of mathematical situations by writing and executing code, including code that involves conditional statements and other control structures

levels.descriptor: Writes one branch of IF-THEN with prompts.
Writes complete two-branch IF-THEN code for a math task.
Writes 3-branch IF-THEN-ELSE-IF code; explains the structure.

rows.expectation_text: read and alter existing code, including code that involves conditional statements and other control structures, and describe how changes to the code affect the outcomes

levels.descriptor: Cannot read or alter IF-THEN code.
Traces and predicts outcomes; alters code and predicts new outcomes.
Identifies which inputs change after alteration; describes boundary cases.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Apply this rubric to combined evidence from Lesson 5 capstone.
summative_rubric.layout_description: One letter page, landscape. 5-column grid with 2 rows.

summative_task_script.title: Lesson 5 Summative Task — My IF-THEN Code
administration_steps: Walk through the Capstone IF-THEN Template.
Circulate; prompt children stuck on missing branches.
Score: code + 3 traces = L3; plus alteration and reflection = L4.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Coherent code with both branches (out of 3) + 3 correct traces (out of 3) + alteration with re-traces (out of 3) + reflection (out of 1) = 10.

evidence_per_expectation.C3.1: Code includes both branches; covers all inputs.
evidence_per_expectation.C3.2: Traces match code; alteration produces predicted new outcomes.
